items.title: Explained: Want to know how long your investment will take to triple? Use Rule 114
items.summary: Rule 114 helps investors estimate how long mutual fund investments may take to triple based on expected annual returns. Dividing 114 by the return rate gives the approximate timeframe, supporting long-term financial…

items.title: REC and Cochin Shipyard among top 5 midcap stocks that saw highest mutual fund selling in September
items.summary: Mutual funds recorded their highest September net selling in five midcap stocks: Rail Vikas, Lodha Developers, REC, Cochin Shipyard and Hindustan Copper, according to Motilal Oswal Financial Services data.
